scripts.dev:quick: set DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db&& set NODE_ENV=development&& set DB_PROVIDER=sqlite&& set USE_LOCAL_MATCHING=true&& npm run dev -w @np/api
scripts.seed:quick: set DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db&& set NODE_ENV=development&& set DB_PROVIDER=sqlite&& cd apps/api && npx prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema-sqlite.prisma && npx prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema-sqlite.prisma && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.sync:real: set DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db&& set NODE_ENV=development&& set DB_PROVIDER=sqlite&& cd apps/api && npx tsx ../../scripts/sync-real-candidates.ts
scripts.prepare:lite: npm run build -w @np/shared && npm run build:web -w @np/mobile && npm run build:api
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: cd apps/api && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd apps/api && npx prisma db seed
scripts.release:prepare: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run prepare:lite
scripts.release:rollback: git revert HEAD --no-edit && git push origin main
